color_evidence.basis: Estimated from the independently saved archive front image; not official HEX.

observations: Historical 1983/84 Away is plain white in the low-resolution team photo. The visible dark chest mark is removed. Collar/cuff fine detail cannot be recovered; no invented trim. Latest independently evidenced away kit selected after checking the team history under the 25 September latest-equipment instruction. Actual source season retained. Colors estimated; fine print and obscured construction adapted to the common silhouette. Original PNG fabric, alpha and physical round collar preserved. Crests, sponsors, manufacturer symbols and lettering removed.
omitted: Emblems, logos, sponsors and lettering. Original PNG collar construction retained.
